pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed polygonal geometries with jagged, stellate edge profiles. Darker pigment centers transition to slightly lighter gradients at the margins. Spatial area of patches is highly variable, with largest contiguous regions located on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness of corridors is non-uniform, widening significantly toward the ventral region and narrowing into thin, high-contrast filaments on the upper neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense serrated silhouette along the upper neck ridge. The amplitude of the jagged contour is low, with a high-frequency repetition of individual hair tufts visible against the sky background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, light-colored pendulous protrusion or growth is visible on the ventral midline, likely located in the umbilical or preputial region.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant directional motion blur is present on the left-hand side of the frame (anterior neck area), resulting in lower pixel clarity compared to the posterior flank.
